intro.heading: Made slowly, finished in black glass.
intro.body: LUMINA formulas are mixed in small batches and bottled in heavy black glass that keeps light away from the ingredients.

story.heading: Why black glass
paragraphs: Light breaks down active ingredients. Clear and frosted bottles look soft on a shelf, but they let the formula fade before the bottle is empty.
Black glass is heavier to ship and harder to make. It keeps every product as fresh on the last day as on the first.
